entities.name: CSRP2 / CRP2
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Homo sapiens CSRP2 (UniProt Q16527); 193 aa, 100% identity and coverage, E-value 2.5e-153.
Contains two LIM domains: residues 10–65 and 119–175; LIM domains are cysteine/histidine-rich zinc-binding interaction modules.
Annotated as a nuclear protein and also detected in cytoplasm, focal adhesions, and Z discs.
Interacts with KAT14 through LIM domain 1 and with GLRX3.
Associated with actinin binding, structural constituent of muscle, muscle tissue development, sarcomere organization, and cell differentiation.
Expression is drastically down-regulated by PDGF-BB or cell injury, conditions associated with smooth-muscle proliferation and dedifferentiation; implicated in embryonic vascular-system development.

entities.name: KAT14
observations: CSRP2/CRP2 LIM domain 1 is reported to mediate interaction with KAT14.

entities.name: GLRX3
observations: CSRP2/CRP2 is reported to interact with GLRX3.

entities.name: Muscle tissue development
observations: CSRP2/CRP2 has a reviewed Gene Ontology biological-process annotation for muscle tissue development.

entities.name: Sarcomere organization
observations: CSRP2/CRP2 has a reviewed Gene Ontology biological-process annotation for sarcomere organization.
